steps.label: cmake configure ncnn
steps.cmd: export PATH="$HOME/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH" && cd ~/ncnn && CC=$(command -v clang-18 || command -v clang) CXX=$(command -v clang++-18 || command -v clang++) cmake -B build -DNCNN_BUILD_TOOLS=OFF -DNCNN_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DNCNN_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF -DNCNN_BUILD_BENCHMARK=OFF -DNCNN_VULKAN=OFF -DNCNN_SHARED_LIB=OFF -DNCNN_ARM86SVE=OFF -DNCNN_ARM86SVE2=OFF -DNCNN_ARM86SVEBF16=OFF -DNCNN_ARM86SVEI8MM=OFF -DNCNN_ARM86SVEF32MM=OFF

steps.label: cmake build ncnn
steps.cmd: export PATH="$HOME/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH" && cd ~/ncnn && cmake --build build -j$(nproc 2>/dev/null || sysctl -n hw.ncpu) --target ncnn

steps.label: clone llama.cpp
steps.cmd: cd ~ && rm -rf llama.cpp && git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp llama.cpp

steps.label: cmake configure llama.cpp (ggml, cpu-only)
steps.cmd: export PATH="$HOME/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH" && cd ~/llama.cpp && CC=$(command -v clang-18 || command -v clang) CXX=$(command -v clang++-18 || command -v clang++) cmake -B build -DGGML_METAL=OFF -DGGML_BLAS=OFF -DGGML_ACCELERATE=OFF -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF -DCMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE=ON -DLLAMA_BUILD_TESTS=OFF -DLLAMA_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF -DLLAMA_BUILD_TOOLS=OFF -DLLAMA_BUILD_SERVER=OFF

steps.label: cmake build ggml static libs
steps.cmd: export PATH="$HOME/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH" && cd ~/llama.cpp && cmake --build build -j$(nproc 2>/dev/null || sysctl -n hw.ncpu) --target ggml ggml-base ggml-cpu
